verdict.rationale: Alloy's APIs are versioned: servers are pinned to /v1, and deprecated endpoints carry inline warnings that name migration targets such as the Events API and Investigations. However, there is no standalone versioning or deprecation-policy page and no API changelog, so the documented-policy half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: a published deprecation policy (timelines, sunset guarantees), an API changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Versioning is practiced: the servers pin /v1 and deprecated endpoints carry inline warning callouts with migration targets
